code:
use default
use System.Random

knuth_shuffle(items: LIST[int], random: Random) is
    let i mut = items.count - 1

    while i >= 1 do
        let j = random.next(0, i + 1)
        let value = items[i]

        items[i] = items[j]
        items[j] = value

        i = i - 1
    od
si

let random = Random(42)

let value_sets: int[][] = [[], [10], [10, 20, 30], (1..11) |> collect_array()]

for values in value_sets do
    let items = LIST[int](values)

    knuth_shuffle(items, random)

    write_line(items |> map(v => "{v}") |> join(" "))
od
